rationale: The agent submitted an exchange without authenticating the user or verifying ownership of the order, and did not seek confirmation before performing an order-changing action. It also refunded to PayPal rather than honoring the user’s request for a gift card refund (or explaining why that wasn’t possible). The agent chose a specific replacement (bagless canister) without presenting options or confirming the exact item. Even if the final details might be internally consistent, these steps violate the policy requirements for authentication and confirmation before writes, leading to a fail.
